features.title: CLUB OCEAN 재미 업데이트: HYPE→DROP, 댄스 배틀, 오늘의 클럽 미션, 인생네컷 포토부스, 리액션, 단골/VIP 레벨 (GwangalliClubPlus)
features.build:
Owner's latest words: "클럽은 ㅈㄴ 재밌게 ㅇㅋ? AAA급 퀄 재미" and "클럽 내부도 aaa급으로 모든걸". GwangalliClubPlus already exists (LED wall order/후원 takeovers, ranking boards, show lights, DJ mode, 합석 production): read every existing file first and EXTEND it with new modules; do not rewrite or break what works. Make the club genuinely fun to hang out in for a whole evening, solo or with friends:
1) HYPE 미터 (shared crowd energy, server-authoritative): rises from 음료 orders (by tier), 후원, players dancing on the floor (emote/dance animation playing, inside the dance-floor zone), reactions, DJ pad actions; decays slowly. Shown on the LED wall edge + a slim HUD bar inside the club. At 100% → server-synced DROP event for everyone in the club: 10-second LED countdown with crowd chant text, blackout, then bass-drop show (all lasers/strobes/CO2/confetti/mirror ball at once, LED floor shock-wave, gentle camera bump that respects a 화면 흔들림 끄기 setting), "DROP!" LED animation listing the top hype contributors' nicknames. Everyone on the floor at the drop gets club 포인트 (club rep). Cooldown so drops happen every few minutes at most.
2) 댄스 배틀: stage spot with a prompt; two players (or player vs house NPC dancer if nobody else) battle in 3 rounds of a rhythm mini-game (arrow/tap notes falling in time with the club BPM; works with touch, keyboard, gamepad), the battlers' avatars play dance animations on stage under spotlights, crowd in the club can cheer one side (rate-limited prompt/button) which adds a small bonus. Winner shown big on the LED wall with nickname + crown, club rep reward, and a daily win streak. Fair: server checks timing windows from the client hits with sanity bounds.
3) 오늘의 클럽 미션: 3 daily missions per player picked from a pool (e.g. 음료 2잔 주문, 드롭 때 플로어에 있기, 댄스 배틀 1회 참여, 포토부스 1장, 리액션 10번, 합석 이벤트 참여, DJ 신청곡 1번), progress HUD card, KST daily reset, rewards club rep (+ a small capped money reward through the existing money API only if the design doc shows a safe server function; otherwise rep only). Saved with DataStore (retries, session lock-free merge, memory fallback).
4) 인생네컷 포토부스 (4-cut photo booth) model in the club (Parts, neon frame, ring light, curtain): up to 4 friends inside, pick a frame theme (OCEAN 네온, 광안대교, 레트로, 생일), 3-2-1 countdown x4 with pose prompts, result card UI showing 4 ViewportFrame shots of the actual avatars in their poses + date + 'CLUB OCEAN 광안' logo; the card can be shown on a side LED for a few seconds ("📸 ○○님 일행 인생네컷!"). No real screenshots needed — rebuild the poses in ViewportFrames.
5) 리액션 휠 (Z key / button / gamepad): 환호, 박수, 손 흔들기, 점프, 하트 없이 ⭐/🔥/🎉 emoji bursts over the head (everyone sees, rate-limited), each adds hype.
6) 단골 레벨 (club rep levels): 일반 → 단골 → VIP → 레전드 with thresholds; perks: coloured/neon nickname on LED cards by level, LED entrance welcome "WELCOME VIP ○○" when a VIP+ enters the main hall (cooldown), VIP rope area access if the place has one (else a new VIP riser by the DJ booth with a rope + prompt check), small 음료 discount via the existing order flow only if it can be done safely (else skip). Level-up celebration.
7) 신청곡 (DJ request): players spend club rep to request the next mood (하우스 / EDM / K-POP 리믹스 / 힙합 / 시티팝) that changes the show palette and BPM for one segment; uses existing club music ids from the place if any, else only lights/BPM change.
Rules: all ages (Roblox policy) — drinks are 음료 only (no alcohol words), social/friends framing, no romance/dating wording or hearts, no violence. Everything server-authoritative, validated, rate-limited, cleaned up when players leave the club. Client effects only while inside the club, with quality tiers for phones. Korean UI, natural and fun copy. Test the flows end to end in the temp studio with screenshots (DROP moment, dance battle, photo card, mission card, reaction burst, VIP welcome).

features.title: 코인노래방 실제 곡 지원: 운영자 라이선스 곡(SoundId + 시간 맞춘 가사) + 가사 싱크 도구 (GwangalliKaraokePlus)
features.build:
Owner asked whether real songs are copyrighted and wants it like 팡팡노래방. Answer given to the owner: real songs need a license, so the game ships with the 58 original / public-domain songs and gains a way for the OWNER to add songs they have the rights to (their own uploaded audio). GwangalliKaraokePlus already exists and works (read all files first; extend, don't rewrite). Add:
1) Custom song entries: a song may carry soundId (an audio asset the owner uploaded and is allowed to use) + soundOffset + lrc = { {t = seconds, text = "가사 한 줄"}, ... } (optional per-line end time / duet part prefix {M}/{F}/{A}). When lrc is present the TV lyric colour wipe follows Sound.TimePosition of the backing track (smooth per-character wipe interpolated between line start and next line start), 간주 detection on long gaps, the melody/band synth is OFF (the track is the music), tempo/key buttons hide or show '원곡 반주는 템포/키 고정' hint, scoring falls back to the existing voice-activity / rhythm-tap scoring. Song number / search / charts list them like the built-in songs (genre field, 'new' tag).
2) Where the owner puts them: a pure-data module GwangalliKaraokeShared/CustomSongs.luau returning a list (empty by default, with a commented example entry in Korean explaining: only songs you have the rights to; upload the audio in Creator Hub; paste its id; use the timing tool for lrc). IMPORTANT for the final bundle: the orchestrator also lets the owner put the same list in the server file's config table; so Songs must merge CustomSongs at require time via a function Songs.addCustom(list) that validates fields (types, lengths, max 300 lines, sorted times) and assigns 5-digit numbers in a separate range (e.g. 90001+) unless given; expose it and call it with require(CustomSongs) yourself.
3) 가사 싱크 도구 (lyric timing tool) usable by the owner in Studio play mode (RunService:IsStudio()) or by players with the admin attribute the place already uses (check the design doc / dumped scripts for the admin attribute name): opens from the 리모컨 (hidden button) or chat command '/가사싱크'; paste a soundId and the lyric text (one line per line) into a TextBox, press 재생, tap SPACE / the big 탭 button at the start of each line (undo last tap, ±0.1s nudge, replay from line N, preview with the real wipe), then 내보내기 shows the finished Lua table text in a selectable TextBox (and prints it to Output) ready to paste into CustomSongs. Client-only; never saves anything server-side.
4) Make sure a booth with a custom song stays in sync for everyone in the booth (server start time already exists) and late joiners seek the Sound to the right TimePosition; handle Sound load failures with a Korean message and skip.
Test offline (lrc timing maths, merge/validation) and in the temp studio with a fake soundId (the engine may not play audio: test the timing path with a simulated clock), screenshots of the tool and the TV with a custom song.
